Step-up golden vector (handshake spec §8, E1-09.3; v1). The step-up key (a second P-256 key, which the OS releases only after user verification) signs, ES256 raw r||s base64url, the UTF-8 string "AINKRAD-STEPUP-V1
" + core_fp + "
" + device_id + "
" + session_id + "
" + challenge, with no trailing newline; challenge is exactly the base64url text POST /api/v1/auth/step-up/challenge returned for that session. Signatures are randomised: verify them, never expect to reproduce them. stepup_pkcs8 is a throwaway TEST key made for this file: never use it for anything else.
